scripts.backend:migrate: cd backend && export $(cat .env 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^#' | xargs) && ./mvnw flyway:migrate -Dflyway.url="${DB_URL}" -Dflyway.user="${DB_USERNAME}" -Dflyway.password="${DB_PASSWORD}" && ./mvnw jooq-codegen:generate -Djooq.url="${DB_URL}" -Djooq.user="${DB_USERNAME}" -Djooq.password="${DB_PASSWORD}"
scripts.backend:dev: cd backend && export $(cat .env 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^#' | xargs) && ./mvnw spring-boot:run -Dskip.flyway.migration=true -Dskip.jooq.generation=true
scripts.plugin:package: cd tools/sketchup-plugin && bash package.sh && mkdir -p ../../frontend/apps/nextjs/public/downloads && cp konfiguruj_export.rbz ../../frontend/apps/nextjs/public/downloads/
